summary: The revision resolves four prior findings. Six blocking contract gaps remain in legacy mode, denial handling, candidate origins, demo controls, Marketing coverage, and documentation.

blocking_findings.summary: The Sales legacy contract uses an invalid mode and still omits the start-route gate.
blocking_findings.evidence: spec.md:122-124 and plan.md:86,154 use SALES_AUTH_MODE=legacy. auth-mode.ts:2,13-16 accepts only company or legacy-school. The Sales start route has no legacy gate.

blocking_findings.summary: The role-denial contract still permits an implementation that cannot show the forbidden message.
blocking_findings.evidence: spec.md:100-104 requires a callback redirect and a session denial. plan.md:55 and 91 allow either one. No client task converts a session denial into ?error=forbidden.

blocking_findings.summary: The approved-origin plan cannot prove authenticated behavior on the no-traffic candidate revisions.
blocking_findings.evidence: plan.md:30-35 defines no preview-origin source. Its blast radius excludes both cloudbuild files. Current candidate deployments set no preview-origin variable. Codecamp sets CODECAMP_PREVIEW_ORIGINS and performs a callback-origin handoff. The revised plan specifies neither equivalent handoff. Marketing callback and logout origin changes also lack Red tests.

blocking_findings.summary: The demo credential contract still lacks minimum entropy and expiry controls.
blocking_findings.evidence: spec.md:106-114 and plan.md:60-66 require a cryptographic source and 32 characters. They define no minimum random bytes, account expiry, role expiry, or disable-by date. company-identity/schema/index.ts:441 provides role expiry support.

blocking_findings.summary: The Marketing Red plan does not prove every login redirect preserves its destination.
blocking_findings.evidence: FR-1 and plan.md:44-47 cover every redirect. plan.md:98-102 tests only one page. Current redirects also exist in settings/page.tsx, campaigns/[id]/page.tsx, and campaigns/[id]/video/page.tsx.

blocking_findings.summary: The documentation task names a Sales deployment runbook that does not exist.
blocking_findings.evidence: plan.md:165-168 says to update the Sales deployment runbook and the same document. No runbook exists under apps/sales-advantage, and the plan gives no creation path.

nonblocking_findings.summary: The draft overstates parity with the Codecamp origin rule.
nonblocking_findings.evidence: spec.md:80-88 and plan.md:34,76 require fallback for an unapproved forwarded origin. Codecamp public-url.ts:146 and its test at lines 64-73 reject that origin.

nonblocking_findings.summary: Marketing transaction-cookie expiry remains absent from one planned error path.
nonblocking_findings.evidence: The NFR at spec.md:120-121 covers all error paths. Sales has test and implementation tasks at plan.md:90,133. Marketing has neither. Its callback returns early at lines 18-20 without deleting the cookie.

nonblocking_findings.summary: The Marketing validation wording diverges from the proven client-error flow.
nonblocking_findings.evidence: plan.md:48-51 requires validation before the OIDC client. Codecamp start route.ts:35-40 catches the client ZodError. The shared validator is private at client.ts:74-87.

evidence: RA-A-001 is resolved. FR-1 and plan.md:44-47,98-102,140-144 add Marketing destination recovery. campaigns/page.tsx:48-50 and login/page.tsx:38-40 confirm the cited defect.
RA-A-002 is partly resolved. FR-4 adds origin approval and includes Marketing callback and logout work. RA-A-R2-3 records the remaining candidate contract gap.
RA-A-003 is not fully resolved. The draft adds a forbidden producer decision, but its either-or wording does not guarantee a visible producer.
RA-A-004 is partly resolved. FR-6 removes dead codes. The Sales start route still lacks a legacy gate, and the draft names the wrong mode value.

RA-A-005 is resolved. spec.md:138-140 expects a 307 to the Accounts authorize URL after client.start('/'). Codecamp route.ts:35-41 and its test at lines 119-140 confirm this behavior. Marketing no longer has a language criterion.
RA-A-006 is not fully resolved. Generated passwords, no administrator, rotation, disable, and output checks are present. Entropy and expiry remain unspecified.
RA-A-007 is resolved. spec.md:24 cites client.ts:87 and 293 correctly. spec.md:31 limits the browser audit claim to findings F1-F4.
RA-A-008 is resolved for named app surfaces. plan.md:21-28 now lists Sales and Marketing pages, routes, locale files, scripts, and Accounts seed work.
The Sales callback at lines 21-38 exchanges and stores a session without an app-role check. The session route at lines 7-12 returns a silent null session.
The Sales logout origin comparison remains at route.ts:18-23. Marketing compares the request origin at logout route.ts:11-12.
The plan has 34 top-level tasks, matching metadata.json:8. All four phases have manual verification tasks and checkpoints.
The plan preserves contract-first phases, Red-only rules, candidate verification, scope exclusions, and the named tech-debt owner daniebo.
